title: Missing Manifest Lines
description: A booking submitted with a package block missing one of its dimension fields shouldn't be allowed to slip through with an undefined value silently treated as zero.
successCondition: POST /api/booking as a logged-in customer with a body where the package object is missing the heightCm field entirely (origin and destination are otherwise valid) returns 400 with error.code VALIDATION_ERROR, and no shipment is created — a follow-up GET /api/booking for that account shows no new shipment.
hints: Try the same omission against POST /api/booking/quote too — both routes share the same package schema, so the same field should be required in both places.
Confirm nothing was created by listing your own shipments afterward, not by trusting the 400 status code alone.
